description: The global-rule framework and the Dalaran Heist anomalies and twists (phase 8 family 05): the rule cards DALA_851..DALA_863, DALA_865, DALA_867 (anomalies) and DALA_829, DALA_831, DALA_832, DALA_833 (twists), with the tokens DALA_829t Cache of Cash, DALA_832t Violet Prison and the Carts DALA_833t, t2, t3, t4. The family has no encounter of its own, so this file lists no boss row: the rules are rows of data/dungeon-run/schedule-v1.json "rules" (their incompatibility lists there), scripted in DungeonRunEncounters.F05.cs and admitted in DungeonRunAdmission.F05.cs. This file records where each rule's reading comes from ("rules"); the encounters step of tools/dungeon-run-catalog reads only "bosses" and "rejected". DALA_850, DALA_864 and DALA_866 are family 01's; DALA_830 The Finale is family 18's.
method: Rule texts are the client's (facts/violet-hold-2026-09.json). Where the text leaves a gap, the hearthstone.wiki.gg page named on the rule was read (2026-11-13) and its statement is summarised ("states"); where the wiki states nothing either, the reading is recorded as an adaptation in tools/restoration-ledger/curation.json "ruleAdaptations".

rules.name: Anomaly - Summons
rules.reading: Summoning Stone's rule for both players: a random minion of the Cost the played spell had in hand.

rules.name: Anomaly - Crying
rules.reading: Battle Totem's controller aura on each player.

rules.name: Anomaly - Rattling
rules.reading: Totem of the Dead's controller aura on each player.

rules.name: Anomaly - Nesting
rules.source: client text; client enchantments DALA_854e2 Nested, DALA_854e3 Popped Out (1/1)

rules.name: Anomaly - Glittering

source.states: the anomaly generates Dalaran Heist treasures

rules.reason: the Dalaran Heist treasures are run rewards admitted for the run player's run deck only; a rule for both players needs each admitted for a boss and as a generation result

source.states: a small chance, at the start of each player's turn, that one random Murloc is summoned (no number given)
lists Dragon Spirit as the related card

rules.name: Anomaly - Ogreish
rules.source: client text; client enchantment DALA_861e2 Ogreish ("50% chance to attack the wrong enemy")
rules.reading: Ogre Warmaul's rule for every attacking minion.

source.states: lists the Rogue spell Hallucination (UNG_856) as the related card

rules.name: Anomaly - Explosive
rules.source: client text; client enchantment DALA_865e2 Explosive

source.states: the enemy starts with a 0/3 Cache of Cash in play; when it is destroyed each player gets two Coins
the Health and Attack of all minions are swapped

each player starts with a dormant Violet Prison that holds a random minion; the prison is replaced by that minion after as many turns as the minion costs, and the minion cannot attack that turn without Rush or Charge
each player starts with three random Carts (Dessert, Fish, Meat or Fruit) that are dormant, cannot be removed and only take up board space, so each player can have four minions
